desc: Derive a precise feasibility condition for a candidate distance \(D\) in terms of selecting a minimum-size set of original edges.
Construct the layered graph or equivalent min-cut network and prove that its cut value equals the minimum number of edges that must receive weight 1.
Determine the correct range and monotonicity for binary search or linear search over possible answers.
Verify treatment of “exactly \(K\)” versus “at most \(K\)”, including cases where additional selected edges do not reduce shortest-path distance.
Implement the resulting max-flow/min-cut solution in Python within the constraints \(N \le 30\), \(M \le 100\), with robust support for multi-edges.
